meta.defaultDescription: Camping on Bert's farm in the Netherlands. Chickens, a play meadow with a tractor, an outdoor pool and the old milking parlour. Open from 1 April to 31 October.

accessibility.metaDescription: What is and isn't possible with a wheelchair, a pushchair or a disability at De Groene Weide, and how this website is accessible.
accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.lead: Everyone should be able to enjoy the farm. Here we tell you honestly what is and isn't possible, on the website and on the site itself.
site: Everything works with the keyboard. Press Tab to jump to the next button or link.
The calm mode button at the top turns off motion and sound. If 'reduce motion' is on for your device, we do this automatically.
The site map always comes with a list as an alternative. Every pitch has a name for screen readers.
Colours on the map also have a pattern or symbol, so you can tell them apart without colour.
We follow the WCAG 2.2 guideline, level AA.
accessibility.plotsNote: When you book, you can see for each pitch whether it is level and wheelchair accessible. We only call a pitch accessible if Bert has checked it himself. Last checked: [date].

faq.q: Can I book a pitch close to the accessible toilets and showers?
faq.a: Yes. Mention it when you book or get in touch, and Bert will find you a level pitch nearby.

faq.q: Can my assistance dog come along?
Is there a quiet pitch for guests who are sensitive to noise and busyness?

accessibility.reportText: Is something not working for you? Let us know and we'll fix it.

houseRules.metaDescription: The house rules of De Groene Weide and answers to frequently asked questions about dogs, arrival, electricity and more.
houseRules.title: House rules & frequently asked questions
houseRules.lead: A few agreements so that everyone sleeps well. The chickens go to roost at eight; you're allowed to stay up later.
rules: Quiet on the site from [time] to [time].
Drive at walking pace across the farmyard. Chickens and children have right of way.
Dogs are [welcome/not welcome], on a lead and away from the chickens.
Keep the meadow gates closed. What's inside wants to stay inside.
Children under [age] only swim with an adult.
You can separate your rubbish at the [place]. Glass, plastic and the rest.
houseRules.rulesNote: The exact rules and times will follow from Bert.

faq.a: From 1 April to 31 October. In winter both the meadow and Bert get some rest.

faq.q: What time can I arrive, and when do I need to leave?
faq.a: Arrival from [time], departure by [time]. Arriving later? Give us a call and we'll leave the gate open.
Not every pitch. All motorhome pitches have electricity; for tents and caravans it depends on the pitch. You'll see it when you book.

faq.q: Can I change or cancel my booking?
Can the children help out on the farm?
faq.a: We'd love them to. Every morning they can help feed the chickens. See the calendar for the rest.

privacy.metaDescription: Which data De Groene Weide uses, why, how long we keep it and which cookies the site uses.
privacy.title: Privacy & cookies
privacy.lead: We only ask for what we really need, and we don't sell anything on. Apart from eggs, in the farm shop.

sections.title: Who are we?
paragraphs: De Groene Weide is the campsite on Bert's farm, [address]. Questions about your data can be asked through the contact page or by email to [email address].

sections.title: Which data do we use?
paragraphs: If you send a message through the contact form, we use your name, your email address and your message to answer your question. Nothing more.
If you book, we ask for your name, email address, phone number, the number of people, the type of accommodation and any remarks. We never store payment details on this website.
We do not ask for or store any data about children.

sections.title: How long do we keep it?
paragraphs: We keep messages and the contact details of a booking for [period] after your stay or your message. After that, the system automatically removes your name, email address, phone number and remarks. What remains (which pitch, which nights) no longer says anything about you.

sections.title: Where is your data stored?
paragraphs: The website and all data are on a server in the European Union. We send email through a European email service.

sections.title: Cookies and what is stored in your browser
paragraphs: We don't use tracking cookies. In your browser we only store your cookie choice and whether calm mode is on. They are needed for the site to work and stay on your own device. While you are booking, an essential cookie remembers which pitch is being held for you.
Extras from other websites, such as Facebook posts, stay off until you switch them on. You can always change your choice through Cookie settings at the bottom of every page.
We don't measure visitor statistics at the moment. If we start, it will be without cookies and without being able to recognise you.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You can always ask which data we hold about you, and ask us to correct or delete it. Send us a message and we'll sort it out within a month.
Don't agree with how we handle your data? You can file a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens).
